shortDescription: Brazilian state-run oil firm Petrobras BMFBOVESPA:PETR3 has increased the average price of jet fuel sold to distributors by 13.9%, or 0.68 real ($0,1312) per liter, starting Tuesday, the firm said in a statement.($1 = 5.1815 reais)
